limitations: Two patches with two people each, exponential recovery, symmetric row-stochastic contacts.
General transmission threshold concerns only the local derivative at fully cross-patch mixing; global uniqueness is shown only at transmission ratio 4.
An alternative derivation may be implicit in classical household epidemic theory; detailed historical priority needs independent evaluation.
The finite-population effect is mathematically nonzero but quantitatively small at the ratio-four witness.
scientific_integrity: Exact CTMC expectation identities and polynomial sign certificates independently checked with exact symbolic and rational arithmetic. No claim of independent validation.
title: An exact four-person epidemic mixing reversal and its sharp transmission threshold
